message.content: Video games are increasingly recognized for their therapeutic value, and they are no longer viewed only as a form of entertainment. According to McGonigal (2012), games such as SuperBetter are designed with psychological principles in mind, and they can help people manage anxiety or depression. These games may seem simple, yet they encourage players to take an active role in their own healing, so they can support both emotional and physical recovery.
